title: Garam masala
description: Running low on garam masala? Make your own at home using whole spices and Madhur Jaffrey's recipe.

source.rights: Recipe text belongs to the rights-holder. This corpus stores functional content (ingredients, quantities, steps) plus a link back to the source, for internal app testing only. Not for redistribution.

items.raw: 1 tbsp cardamom seeds (if you can't buy the seeds then buy cardamom pods and shell them yourself)
items.name: cardamom seeds (if you can't buy the seeds then buy cardamom pods and shell them yourself)

items.raw: 1 tsp black cumin seeds (you can use regular cumin seeds if black aren't available)
items.name: black cumin seeds (you can use regular cumin seeds if black aren't available)

items.raw: 1/3 of a whole nutmeg (you can break a whole nutmeg by placing it on a cloth and bashing it with a meat mallet or rolling pin)
items.name: /3 of a whole nutmeg (you can break a whole nutmeg by placing it on a cloth and bashing it with a meat mallet or rolling pin)

items.raw: a medium stick of cinnamon, about 5-8cm/2-3 inches, broken up into 3-4 pieces
items.name: a medium stick of cinnamon, about 5-8cm/2-3 inches, broken up into 3-4 pieces

steps.text: Put all the ingredients in a clean coffee grinder or other spice grinder and grind as finely as possible.
steps.raw: Put all the ingredients in a clean coffee grinder or other spice grinder and grind as finely as possible.

steps.text: Store in a tightly lidded jar, away from heat and sunlight and use as needed.
